comment: GPT OAuth route through the Codex CLI (`codex exec`), one account per CODEX_HOME. The engine never reads, copies, hashes or prints a token: it only checks that <codex_home>/auth.json EXISTS. Codex's built-in image_gen tool writes <codex_home>/generated_images/<session>/exec-<id>.png (how the shipped anchors were made). Quota/usage messages and the 1 h default cooling are POLICY (GUESS).
